October 2026: 1 Oct is a Thursday, 31 Oct is a Saturday. So the only Mon–Sun week fully inside October is **5–11 October**. The partial weeks at each end (1–4 Oct and 26–31 Oct) get excluded.

That gives you a single week's figures — probably too thin to be useful on its own. If you want more coverage, options are:
- Include the partial weeks and label them as such
- Use a 4-week retail calendar (e.g. 4–31 Oct) instead of calendar weeks

Send the daily figures and I'll produce the table for 5–11 Oct, plus the October total for context.
